svg.title: saiefr — terminal profile
svg.desc: An amber-phosphor CRT terminal types a session — whoami, fastfetch and cat now.txt — introducing saiefr: a LegalTech lawyer and cyberdefense student from Argentina, with the Warframe Lotus rendered as a glowing dot matrix and an Orokin script flourish.
